{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_length = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the mean values directly to capture them
for species in mean_flipper_length.index:
    print(f"{species}: {mean_flipper_length[species]}")

# Find and print the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_length.idxmax()
print(f"Highest mean species: {highest_mean_species}")"}
